effective.basis: TCG release of the Machine Madness Value Box reprint of SDMM-EN002, the first printing carrying the PSCT text

changes.historical_text: When this card is Normal Summoned, you can add 1 "Machina" monster, except "Machina Gearframe", from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can equip this card to a Machine-Type monster you control as an Equip Card, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)
changes.modern_text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Machina" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Machina Gearframe". Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)
changes.summary: PSCT rewording that keeps the Union Condition intact: colons and "You can either: Target 1 Machine-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: ...", the redundant "during your Main Phase" dropped from what is an Ignition effect either way, and "except \"Machina Gearframe\"" moved to the end of the search clause. The bracketed "(A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)" is still present. Judged from the text lineage alone - no script diff exists for this card - so the spelled-out "Target" is read as PSCT codification of the existing selection, not a targeting change.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing without the Union Condition (SR10-EN005, Structure Deck: Mechanized Madness)

changes.historical_text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Machina" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Machina Gearframe". Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)
changes.modern_text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Machina" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Machina Gearframe". Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.
changes.summary: Functional erratum: the Condition "(A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time.)" is deleted, so the modern Gearframe may sit on a Machine monster that already carries another Union monster, and the unequip mode loses its "in face-up Attack Position" requirement, letting the controller choose the battle position of the Special Summoned Gearframe. The destruction substitution is simultaneously narrowed in wording to "destroyed by battle or card effect".

gap.reason: Project Ignis ships no historical implementation of this card; reproducing the era behaviour needs a custom script and a reserved passcode
gap.behavioural_impact: In an Edison snapshot EDOPro lets a player stack Machina Gearframe onto a Machine monster that is already equipped with another Union monster, and Special Summon Gearframe back in Defense Position - both illegal under the era's printed Union Condition and Attack Position clause.

review.notes: upstream_implementations is empty; no goat or pre-errata variant of 42940404 exists upstream. Edison (2010-04-24) falls on v0 (SDMM-EN002, Machina Mayhem Structure Deck, 2010-02-19 EU / 2010-02-23 NA) - the era text, complete with the Union Condition. Corroboration from EdisonFormat.com's Functional Errata list, quoted from the transcription in briefs/edison-functional-errata.md (entry "Machina Gearframe (and all Union Monsters)"): "in Edison every Union Monster carries the Condition limiting a monster to 1 equipped Union Monster at a time". The site attributes the removal to the 2016 Structure Deck: Seto Kaiba; that is the community's own claim and is NOT used here for chronology - this card's own lineage dates the removal to SR10-EN005 (2020-04-16), which is the anchor used. cards.cdb matches v2 exactly.
